date: 2026-08-20

  html:
    toc: true

---

This module validates only the pseudonymized Parquet hand-off. Raw REDCap
extracts, linkage tables, free text, and direct identifiers are outside the
public pipeline. Required, optional, and pending domains are reported
separately; a required domain or the data-lock manifest cannot be silently
treated as absent.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "data_validate_inputs"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
validation_path <- file.path(result_dir, "input-validation.parquet")

domain_registry <- data.frame(
  domain = c(
    "cohort_follow_up", "recruitment", "ctdna_samples", "alterations",
    "trial_referral", "biopsy", "blood_products", "imaging", "qol",
    "taooh", "physical_function", "progression_bsc", "treatment_lines",
    "weekly_treatment", "solid_msi", "solid_tmb", "treatment_details"
  ),
  role = c(
    "required", "required", rep("optional", 10), rep("pending", 5)
  ),
  schema_available = c(rep(TRUE, 14), FALSE, FALSE, FALSE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

manifest_info <- read_private_manifest_if_present(config)
if (is.null(manifest_info)) {
  stop("The pseudonymized data manifest is missing under data/private; ",
       "the lock and domain availability cannot be validated.")
}
manifest <- manifest_info$manifest
validate_data_manifest(
  manifest,
  expected_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
  private_dir = project_path(config_get(config, "paths", "private_data"))
)

parquet_files <- list.files(
  project_path(config_get(config, "paths", "private_data")),
  pattern = "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE
)
file_domains <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(parquet_files))
unknown_files <- setdiff(file_domains, domain_registry$domain)
if (length(unknown_files) > 0L) {
  stop("Private Parquet has no approved public schema: ", paste(unknown_files, collapse = ", "))
}

schema_paths <- vapply(
  domain_registry$domain[domain_registry$schema_available],
  function(domain) schema_domain_path(config, domain),
  character(1)
)
input_paths <- c(parquet_files, manifest_info$path, schema_paths[file.exists(schema_paths)])
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = validation_path,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "00-data", "01-validate-inputs.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  validation_summary <- read_result_table(validation_path)
} else {
manifest_domains <- manifest$domains
manifest_names <- names(manifest_domains)
validation_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(domain_registry)), function(index) {
  domain <- domain_registry$domain[[index]]
  role <- domain_registry$role[[index]]
  file_path <- private_domain_path(config, domain)
  schema_path <- schema_domain_path(config, domain)
  manifest_record <- if (domain %in% manifest_names) manifest_domains[[domain]] else NULL
  status <- if (role == "pending") "pending" else "missing_optional"
  message <- NA_character_
  n_rows <- NA_integer_
  if (role == "pending") {
    message <- "Source fields are not part of the approved public contract."
  } else if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    status <- if (role == "required") "missing_required" else "missing_optional"
    message <- "No pseudonymized Parquet was supplied at the data lock."
  } else if (!file.exists(schema_path)) {
    status <- "schema_missing"
    message <- "Approved schema is missing."
  } else if (is.null(manifest_record)) {
    status <- "manifest_entry_missing"
    message <- "Domain is not recorded in the data manifest."
  } else if (!isTRUE(manifest_record$available)) {
    status <- if (role == "required") "manifest_marks_unavailable" else "unavailable"
    message <- "The data manifest marks this domain unavailable."
  } else {
    validated <- validate_private_parquet(file_path, schema_path)
    status <- "validated"
    n_rows <- nrow(validated$data)
    message <- "Schema, primary key, requiredness, lock, and PHI checks passed."
  }
  data.frame(
    domain = domain,
    role = role,
    status = status,
    n_rows = n_rows,
    message = message,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
validation_summary <- do.call(rbind, validation_rows)
rownames(validation_summary) <- NULL

if (any(validation_summary$status %in% c("missing_required", "schema_missing",
                                          "manifest_entry_missing", "manifest_marks_unavailable"))) {
  write_module_table(validation_summary, validation_path)
  stop("Required public input validation did not pass; inspect input-validation.parquet.")
}

write_module_table(validation_summary, validation_path)
finalize_module_checkpoint(
  stage_id = stage_id,
  checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
  input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = validation_path,
  config = config,
  metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                  status = "validated"),
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "00-data", "01-validate-inputs.qmd")
)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: validation-status
#| tbl-cap: "Public input-domain validation status"

validation_summary |>
  transform(n_rows = ifelse(is.na(n_rows), "not available", as.character(n_rows))) |>
  subset(select = c(domain, role, status, n_rows, message)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
